apis.description: The caller's Google Drive, read through the Drive API v3 with the caller's own access token. The declaration carries no credential: the Authorization header is the ${GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN} placeholder, expanded from the environment when the declaration is loaded, so the token itself is never written into a file. Only GET operations are declared, so the read-only default method set applies — listing, metadata and account reads; no upload, edit or delete endpoint is declared.
apis.name: googledrive
